question: Which selected mechanisms change complete execution time on a predeclared subset?
scope: Synthetic offline mechanism comparison on reps 00..03 of the already frozen fresh confirmation panel; not a new independent performance panel.

ablations.no_posterior_optical: Q3: only posterior_optical=False; Cost5 probe ranking and all posterior history retained.
ablations.no_cost_pair: Q3: override only choose_pair to original(track, **kwargs), the pre-ranking geometric pair; the original nearest_pair wrapper and posterior optical choice remain. Do not delegate to PosteriorMixin, which still costs candidates.
ablations.no_transit: Q4: only intercept_cap=0; stationary information, known scan gate, route suffix and all geometry retained.
ablations.no_known_gate: Q4: only scan_gain_m=None; scan_count_stop=True and every other selected setting retained.

metric: Per-case complete virtual time / actual successful clears, then arithmetic case mean. All bad cases retained; mean invalid if any run fails.
checks: Every run recomputes actual timing and physics, full range audit, Q3 negative geometry, complete clearing and termination. Complete-policy action/time equality against fresh confirmation is also checked.
repeated_runs: Complete-policy runs are deliberate reproduction of existing frozen cases; they are not additional independent cases.
